network_check.command: grep -rnE 'fetch\s*\(|https?\.request\s*\(|https?\.get\s*\(|WebSocket\s*\(|XMLHttpRequest|axios|urllib|requests\.|http\.client|socket\.|net\.connect|from\s+http|import\s+http|from\s+socket|import\s+socket|\bcurl\b' src/core/e2e.ts src/core/workflow-parser.ts src/core/glob-subset.ts src/core/job-dag.ts src/core/check-resolver.ts oracle/checkpath_oracle/parser.py oracle/checkpath_oracle/evaluator.py oracle/checkpath_oracle/glob_subset.py oracle/checkpath_oracle/resolver.py oracle/checkpath_oracle/canonical.py oracle/checkpath_oracle/cli.py

notes: gate_report_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of this file with the gate_report_sha256 field removed. Recompute with: python3 -c "import json,hashlib; d=json.load(open('evidence/S0_GATE.json')); h=d.pop('gate_report_sha256'); print(hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(d,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()); print('recorded:',h)"
input_fixture_sha256 covers tests/fixtures/s0/all.json plus every fixture workflow/scenario/required-checks/expected file, sorted by path; see evidence/s0/T004_REPORT.md for the recompute command.

Runtime network calls are 0 by construction (local processes only) and by static check over the executed implementation files; the runner itself (scripts/oracle-diff.mjs) is excluded from the grep because it contains the pattern table as string literals, and it only spawns local vitest/python3/npm/node/grep processes.
PyYAML actually used by the Oracle is 6.0.1 (system); lockfile pins 6.0.3, pip install blocked by PEP 668 (T001 D2).
